command:
set -eu
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'LOG_META\n'; sudo -n stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' /var/log/inventory/app.log 2>&1 || true
printf 'LOG_TAIL\n'; sudo -n tail -n 5 /var/log/inventory/app.log 2>&1 || true
printf 'MATCHING_CONFIG\n'; sudo -n grep -R -n -F '/var/log/inventory/app.log' /etc/logrotate.conf /etc/logrotate.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'WRITERS\n'; sudo -n fuser -v /var/log/inventory/app.log 2>&1 || true
printf 'SERVICES\n'; systemctl --no-pager --plain --type=service --state=running | grep -Ei 'inventory|app' || true

    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
